scoring_justification: The spinodal temperatures and critical point are derived from short-time dynamics Monte Carlo simulations; recomputing from raw simulation data is infeasible in the verifier sandbox. Instead, the checker cross-validates the agent's reported values against the paper's published reference values within the paper's stated error bars.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference gold values for spinodal temperatures and critical point for truncated LJ fluid (rc=2.5σ).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: gas spinodal at p=0.04: T_sp=0.85±0.02; at p=0.10: 1.155±0.003; at p=0.1105: 1.1875±0.0015. Liquid spinodal at p=0.04: 1.105±0.005; at p=0.10: 1.175 (from intersection of fits, tolerance 0.005); at p=0.1105: 1.1875±0.0015. Critical point: p_c=0.1105±0.0015, T_c=1.1875±0.0015.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription of the paper's reported values and error bars.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are from the paper's main results (Fig.4, Fig.5 and text). No fabricated values.

output_contract.notes: All temperatures and pressures are in reduced LJ units. The agent's reported values will be compared to the hidden reference values with tolerances based on the paper's stated error bars.
